list.noModule: Recording and transcription are not switched on for the call centre.
list.noAccess: You do not have access to calls in this call centre.
list.title: Calls
list.intro: Recording, transcription and AI control against the product template.
list.searchHint: Words from the call, customer, title or reference (VQ-…).
list.searchPlaceholder: Words from the call, customer or title
list.emptyRecord: Record the first one in <link>Call studio</link>. It is transcribed while you talk and checked against the product template afterwards.
list.emptyView: The calls you can see will appear here once they have been recorded.
list.limit: Showing the latest 200. Use search and filters to find older calls.

studio.noAccess: You do not have access to record calls.
studio.title: Call studio
studio.intro: The customer must know that the call is being recorded. Choose the template the call should be checked against before you start.
studio.star: Set as default template for Call studio
studio.where: Where is the call taking place?
studio.tabShared: The tab is already being shared and will be reused without a new dialogue.
studio.tabStep1: Start the call in the browser tab (web telephony, Teams, Zoom or similar). Chrome and Edge on PC and Mac only.
studio.tabStep2: Press ‘Start recording’ and choose the tab where the call is taking place.
studio.tabStep3: Tick ‘Share tab audio’. Without it, there is no sound from the tab.
studio.tabStep4: Press ‘Share’. Use headphones so the customer only comes in through the tab audio.
studio.uploads: {uploaded, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} saved.
studio.uploadsPending: {uploaded, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} saved, {pending} waiting.
studio.uploadsFailing: Cannot upload right now; trying again. Do not close the page.
studio.realtimeLost: The real-time text dropped out. Recording continues, and the text now arrives in pieces, roughly every 15 seconds.
studio.uploadFatal: {message} Recording does not stop, but new parts are not saved.
studio.tabEnded: Tab sharing has ended. Stop the recording, or continue with the microphone only.
studio.stopFailed: {message} The recording is saved; you can finish it from the call page.
studio.chooseAudio: Choose an audio file (for example mp3, m4a, wav or webm).
studio.tooLarge: The audio file is too large. It can be at most 200 MB.
studio.customerHint: Optional. Can also be linked afterwards.
studio.saleHint: Choose the sale the call concerns, so the template version the sale was made on is used.
studio.referenceHint: Paste the reference where the sale is registered. It finds the call again in case of a complaint or review.
studio.transcriptEmpty: Start the recording and the text will appear here.
studio.infoHintRegenerate: Used when a note is written. If you have changed it, press ‘Regenerate’ for a new note. The AI control only uses what was said.
studio.notesBefore: The note is written by AI once the call has been transcribed, based on the transcript and the template.

recorder.tabCancelled: Sharing was cancelled. Choose the tab where the call is taking place and try again.
recorder.noTabAudio: No sound from the tab. Tick ‘Share tab audio’ when you choose the tab, and try again.
recorder.noMicrophone: Could not access the microphone. Allow the browser to use the microphone and try again.
recorder.incompleteUpload: The recording could not be fully uploaded: {detail}
recorder.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.

detail.incompleteText: The recording was not ended. What has been uploaded can be sent for transcription.
detail.waiting: {stage, select, processing {The call is being transcribed} checking {AI is checking the call} other {The note is being written}}. The page updates by itself.

analysis.title: AI control
analysis.checkedAgainst: Checked against {product}, template version {version}. AI can make mistakes; check the quote in the recording.
analysis.commentHint: What has been done about the deviation, for example raised with the seller or the customer contacted.

links.title: Links
links.productHint: When a product is linked, the call is checked against the current product template.

templates.noAccess: You do not have access to note templates.
templates.title: Note templates
templates.intro: AI writes a note after every call using the default template. Without a default template of your own, VeriQall's standard note is used. In Call studio, the seller can create several notes from the same call with other templates.
templates.none: No templates of your own yet.
templates.name: Name
templates.instructionsHint: What the note should contain, in which order and how long it should be.

notes.title: Notes
notes.whenTranscribed: The note is written once the call has been transcribed.
notes.reportsOff: Reports are not switched on for the call centre.
notes.regenerateChosen: Creates new notes from the same transcript with the note templates chosen at the top.
notes.failed: The note could not be created.
notes.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
notes.aiGenerated: AI-generated from the transcript and the chosen template, {date}.
notes.label: Note
notes.aiKept: The AI version is kept, and the change is saved with your name.

picker.standardOnly: The note is written using VeriQall's standard note.
picker.gives: Gives {count, plural, one {one note} other {# notes}} from the call.
picker.noneChosen: None chosen: the note is written using {name}.

additionalInfo.title: Additional information
additionalInfo.placeholder: Optional. For example an agreement the customer already has.
additionalInfo.hint: Included when the note is written, marked as information from the seller. The AI control only uses what was said.

transcript.title: Transcription
transcript.liveRealtime: The text appears here while you talk …
transcript.livePieces: The text arrives in pieces, roughly every 15 seconds …
transcript.speaker: Speaker {speaker}
transcript.footer: The transcription is made from the recording and cannot be changed. Speakers 1 and 2 are separated automatically and may swap places.

lamps.chooseTemplate: Choose a template to see the points that must be covered in the call.
lamps.off: AI control is not switched on for the call centre, or the call is not linked to a template.
lamps.analysed: The lamps are set by AI based on the transcript. AI can make mistakes; check the quote in the recording.
lamps.pending: The lamps light up once the call has been transcribed and checked against the template.

log.title: Log
log.intro: Who has opened, played and reviewed the call, and when.
log.searched: Saw an excerpt in a search
